newsitem.title: USA: Hills Stores stake raised by DDJ group.
newsitem.headline: Hills Stores stake raised by DDJ group.

text.p: A group led by DDJ Capital Management LLC said Monday it raised its stake in Hills Stores Co to the equivalent of 891,184 common shares, or 8.74 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 124,000 additional shares of Hills Stores betrween September 5 and October 28 for $937,097.
The group said its stake includes 550 shares it will receive on conversion of Series A convertible preferred stock of Hills Stores that it holds.
The group previously held a stake of about 7.5 percent in Hills Stores, a Canton, Mass.,-based discount retailer.
